evidence.sentence: In addition, we ensure that our products adhere to internationally recognised standards such as UL standards, FM approvals and CE certification for foam bladder tanks, demonstrating compliance with European safety directives (“CE Marking”), ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management Systems), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management Systems), and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems), for its quality management system.

Our manufacturing units hold CE Marking, indicating compliance with European safety directives as well as certifications under the International Organization for Standardization (“ISO”), including ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management Systems), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management Systems), and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems), for its quality management system.
We also hold Bureau of Indian Standards (“BIS”) certification for stand post type water and foam monitor for fire protection, which is renewed from time to time.

According to the CRISIL Report, on page 144, we were second-largest manufacturer of fire protection equipment and systems in India in terms of operating income (revenue from operations) in Fiscal 2025 and the largest exporter by value (equipment) in Fiscal 2025.

According to the CRISIL Report on page 203, we were the second-largest manufacturer of fire protection equipment and systems in India in terms of operating income (revenue from operations) in Fiscal 2025 and the largest exporter by value (equipment) in Fiscal 2025.

We also specialize in custom-engineered fire protection skids tailored to client-specific requirements and are the only Indian manufacturer to offer certain advanced systems, such as a next-generation pre-action system.

Additionally, our business benefits from infrastructure and industrial-related government initiatives such as Viksit Bharat 2047, and Make in India, which promote new construction and capacity expansion in key sectors.

If policies that support local manufacturing, such as Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes or import restrictions on fire safety components, are withdrawn or modified, it could impact our margins and sourcing strategies.

We may not successfully protect our technical know-how, proprietary information, or patents and any unauthorised disclosure, use, or infringement, which may result in the loss of our competitive advantage and adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.

We have registered patents in the United States of America, India, Turkey and Saudi Arabia for "Pressure Operated Fluid Valve with Configurable Diaphragm Arrangement” and hold 4 design registrations in India and 2 design registrations in the European Union for "Diaphragm of Fire Protection Valve".
We have 1 pending patent application in the United Arab Emirates and 3 patent applications pending in India.

Further, we rely on short-term work orders and do not have long-term contracts or exclusivity arrangements with our customers which exposes us to demand volatility, procurement risks, and customer concentration, which may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows.
